**Uncensored**, an original encode from BD (mostly). I include both the regular episode 3 cut that's on the disc and a Complete Edition. The latter includes all the content such as the Byakudan Midori rooftop scene and some other edits from I-forget-where that showed up in some other releases. I had to splice from multiple sources, including some lower-quality leak rip for the Byakudan scene, with the end product being all uncensored. This was encoded... last year? I don't really remember the status of this.

This replaces the prior [torrent 2333257](https://sukebei.nyaa.si/view/2333257), which did not include the alternate episode 3. There are some video quality improvements over my earlier encode on all of the episodes and certainly over the actual source, which is some garbage upscale with lots of problems. No English audio, as most probably don't want it anyway and it is not available for the extra Complete Edition scenes for the third episode. So hooray for consistency?

No subtitles. If many people ask, maybe I will be more motivated to spend the time retiming and editing this, but no promises.
